name: Utopía: El Nacer de los Héroes
source:
Utopia: Birth of the Heroes is a character‑driven fantasy visual novel about conviction, sacrifice, and the price of protecting those who matter most.

The story follows three distinct protagonists, each driven by a different vision of a perfect society. They’ll navigate hardship, political tension, and morally charged decisions. Every perspective reveals a different truth, and every “hero” believes that what they are doing is right and just.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4235700/Utopia_Birth_of_The_Heroes/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《乌托邦：英雄的诞生》是一部以角色为主导的奇幻视觉小说，讲述了信念、牺牲以及保护最重要的人所付出的代价。

这个故事讲述了三个截然不同的主角，每个主角都被完美社会的不同愿景所驱动。他们将应对困难、政治紧张局势和道德决定。每一种视角都揭示了不同的真相，每一位“英雄”都相信自己所做的事情是正确和正义的。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4235700/Utopia_Birth_of_The_Heroes/]Steam[/url]]
